summary: Hiker with a history of severe bee-sting reactions stung on the Colorado Trail near the North Fork Trailhead without an EpiPen; located by Flight for Life via light-flash signals and walked out with assistance
location: Colorado Trail near North Fork Trailhead
responding_agency: Park County SAR + Flight for Life + Jefferson/Como Fire Protection District + South Park Ambulance
notes: Date approximate: early August 2016; listed as first of month. Darkness and a vague destination description hampered the search; a litter team followed but proved unnecessary.
